1. **Broadcast CREATE slots are position-keyed & deterministic** per deploy-position in a serialized single-suite run (`this` = 0x7FA9385bE102ac3EAc297483Dd6233D62b3e1496 in both ProbeEng29b/c and golden suites — identical logs):

   - pos2 = 0x90193C961A926261B756D1E5bb255e67ff9498A1 (V2 factory, golden case-5)

Probe stage-3b = 15-line proof.

Vendored `lib/forge-std/src/Vm.sol` also lacks both + `clearMockCall` (only global `clearMockedCalls` @L2506, useless for same-tx ordering). Per 1125-5 precedent (transact arities audit), declaring missing cheats in Vm.sol just yields "unknown cheatcode".
5. L45 `bill.token()` ≡ constructor-arg ≡ local `usdc` by code; L47 fresh-bill invariant; V2-L28 factory lineage set in constructor one line above — FAIL arms remain **dead-defense, unreachable in forge test @1.9.0**. 26A classification stands, now with receipts.
